name: 1,4-BENZDIAZEPIN-2-ONE-5(26F-PH)7CL
summary: Ro07-3953 (Diflunordazepam) is a benzodiazepine derivative which is the 2',6'-difluoro derivative of nordazepam. It was invented in the 1970s but was never marketed, however it has recently appeared on the market as a designer drug, first reported in Sweden in December 2024.
